label: Diagram 2.3
caption: Diagram 2.3 Alternative cavity barrier arrangements in roof space over protected stairway in a house with a storey more than 4.5m above ground level
description: The drawing is a cross-section showing two alternative arrangements, labelled a. and b., each depicting a two-storey house with a pitched roof and a grey-shaded protected stairway occupying the right-hand side from ground to roof. In both, the space under the roof is labelled "Unoccupied space", the stairway enclosure is labelled "Fire resisting enclosure to protected stairway REI 30", the grey stairway is labelled "Protected stairway", and a vertical dimension on the left, measured from ground level up to the first floor (the horizontal line between the two storeys), is marked "4.5m". The note "See para 2.5" appears at the top left. In arrangement a., a short angled line within the roof over the stairway is labelled "Cavity barrier E 30 and EI 15". In arrangement b., that angled line is replaced by a horizontal line at eaves level across the roof, labelled "Fire resisting ceiling EI 30". The caption along the bottom reads "Diagram 2.3 Alternative cavity barrier arrangements in roof space over protected stairway in a house with a storey more than 4.5m above ground level".
